acceptance: GATE (task T017): drill on a pilot board — keeper disabled, detector escalation fires to both targets within one detector interval of the threshold. Live jobs for the pilot boards are created at Phase 6 genesis (T027/T028); this file is the scheduling definition they instantiate.
condition: No heartbeat event appended for more than two keeper-cadence intervals (pilot: 60 minutes at the 30-minute cadence) while any wait is open or any non-terminal row exists. Liveness is read only from heartbeat events; no other event kind makes a dead keeper look alive.
escalation: One record per target in the outbox directory (outside the board): every open wait's named escalation target, plus the board's genesis escalation_target_2 — never single-hop, never dependent on the keeper or its chat being alive. Records are keyed by episode (the last heartbeat's event id), so repeat runs in one episode write no duplicates. The staffing job delivers each record to its target's channel; when appends resume, the records are appended to the board as detector_escalation events (python3 -m board.detector record <board_dir> <outbox_dir>, also run by the keeper at the start of each pass).
purpose: Detect a dead keeper from the board log's heartbeat events alone and escalate outside the board (spec AB-001 5.4, task T017).
staffing: The board's genesis detector_chat — a different chat from the keeper's owning chat, named at genesis. The detector must not share the keeper's failure modes.
verdict_rule: The detector's verdict is its outbox records and, once appends resume, the detector_escalation events in the board's log — not this job's completion state.
